description: This file defines message actions for the 'signal' provider, including handling reactions such as sending and removing reaction signals, and provides an adapter for message tool description and action support.

classes.name: ChannelMessageActionAdapter
classes.description: Interface for channel message actions, including describing message tools, support checks, and handling actions.

methods.name: normalizeSignalReactionRecipient
methods.description: Normalizes raw recipient strings by trimming, removing 'signal:' prefix, and handling UUIDs.

methods.name: resolveSignalReactionTarget
methods.description: Resolves raw input into a target object with recipient or groupId.

methods.name: mutateSignalReaction
methods.description: Performs adding or removing a reaction signal based on parameters.
